# uptimekuma_notification_freemobile (Resource)

Free Mobile notification resource

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "uptimekuma_notification_freemobile" "example" {
  name       = "Free Mobile SMS Alerts"
  user       = "YOUR_FREE_MOBILE_USER_ID"
  pass       = "YOUR_FREE_MOBILE_API_KEY"
  is_active  = true
  is_default = false
}

resource "uptimekuma_notification_freemobile" "production" {
  name       = "Free Mobile Production Alerts"
  user       = "1234567890"
  pass       = "your_api_key_here"
  is_active  = true
  is_default = true
}

# Requires Terraform or OpenTofu 1.11 or later: pass_wo is never stored in
# plan or state. Change pass_wo_version whenever the secret changes.
resource "uptimekuma_notification_freemobile" "write_only" {
  name = "Free Mobile with a write-only secret"

  user = "12345678"

  pass_wo         = "your-free-mobile-api-key"
  pass_wo_version = "1"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Notification name
- `user` (String) Free Mobile user ID

### Optional

> **NOTE**: [Write-only arguments](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments) are supported in Terraform 1.11 and later.

- `apply_existing` (Boolean)
- `is_active` (Boolean)
- `is_default` (Boolean)
- `pass` (String, Sensitive) Free Mobile API key. Stored in state; use `pass_wo` to keep it out of state.
- `pass_wo` (String, Sensitive, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) Free Mobile API key, write-only: sent to Uptime Kuma on create and update but never stored in plan or state. Requires Terraform 1.11 or OpenTofu 1.11 or later. Conflicts with `pass`; requires `pass_wo_version`. An imported resource has no `pass_wo_version` yet, so `terraform import` may store the server's value in `pass` until the next apply with `pass_wo` set removes it from state.
- `pass_wo_version` (String) Any value that changes whenever `pass_wo` changes, for example a counter or a hash of the secret's encrypted source. A change triggers an update that sends the current `pass_wo`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (Number) Notification identifier
